title: Threats & Attacks
overview: Module 4 is where you go on offense, carefully. You'll learn how attackers target credentials, crack password hashes using industry-standard tools, and analyze what those results mean for an organization's security posture. Your client is Alamo Industries, assessed across two very different environments. Lab 4.1 cracks Windows (NTLM) hashes from Alamo's corporate office. Lab 4.2 moves to Linux (SHA-512) hashes from the plant floor. In EP 4 you deliver one password security assessment to Alamo comparing the two.

units_breakdown.labDesc: Crack NTLM hashes from Alamo Industries' Windows corporate office using John the Ripper and Hashcat. Learn why unsalted hashes are a structural weakness.
Crack SHA-512 hashes from Alamo's Linux plant floor. Compare salted Linux hashes to NTLM: the difference is dramatic.

units_breakdown.labTitle: Module 4 Engagement Packet: Password Security Assessment
units_breakdown.labDesc: Client engagement. Compile your findings into one password security report for Alamo, comparing its two environments and recommending what to fix first.

clientContext.label: Client Context: Alamo Industries
clientContext.body: Alamo Industries, a San Antonio aerospace and defense manufacturer pursuing CMMC Level 2, runs two very different environments: a Windows corporate office and a Linux plant floor. Elena Vasquez, the IT Manager, owns both and already knows they are not in the same shape. Bobby Alamo III, the CEO, is the executive sponsor. Your cracking results show them exactly where each environment stands and what to fix first.

stakeholders.name: Elena Vasquez
stakeholders.title: IT Manager, Alamo Industries
stakeholders.concern: I own both the corporate domain and the plant-floor systems, and I already know they are not in the same shape. Show me the gap and tell me what to fix first for CMMC.

stakeholders.name: Bobby Alamo III
stakeholders.title: President & CEO, Alamo Industries
stakeholders.concern: CMMC auditors are going to ask about our password policies. We’ve got shop floor accounts older than some of our employees. Show me what we’re actually working with.

footer: Start with Lab 4.1 in the Modules section.
